reason: On $38,000 a year, 59 to 99 euros a month is real money for something I can't picture working in my business yet. I might book the free demo, but I won't pay until someone sets it up and I see actual leads or answered customers.
objection: AI co-workers running things 24/7 sounds great on paper, but I don't know what 100 credits gets me or whether it'll just be another tool I pay for and forget, like my Instagram posts.
would_change_my_mind: A demo where the onboarding team sets it up on my own tools for free and shows me a month of concrete results before I pay anything.
